reconstructed_values.neutral_material_policy: matte slate, graphite, dark rubber and neutral glazing; no logos, decals or manufacturer trade dress

unresolved_choices: Manufacturer-published overall length, overall width and overall height for the selected North American ILS/tyre configuration
Exact tyre, wheel, offset, rear tread and ballast order codes
All hidden ILS, steering and rear-hitch pivots, anchors, link lengths and limits
Exact exterior surfacing and service-detail placement
mechanical_gaps: Left and right ILS roots, arms and cylinders are independent bounded visual articulations without suspension, steering, tyre or terrain physics.
Rear hitch motion is reconstructed and excludes draft sensing, hydraulic pressure, implement mass, PTO driveline and validated swept-volume closure.
Powertrain, cooling, aftertreatment and hydraulic internals are not modeled.
